method: council-domain-tags workflow: two independent taggers per chunk of about 60 works (A: titles and venues read literally; B: which optimization machinery the work most likely contributes), from works.json rows and any abstract already in abstracts.json; a judge agent ruled on every work whose primary codes disagreed. Codes from team.json "domains" plus NONE (not a research work in an optimization domain). Rule: the method domain first and AP second, unless the application or empirical study is the main contribution. Tags drive the domain-balanced reading plan and the domain files; a work's paper card (D1) names its domains again from the full text.
